## Zi’s Structural Engineering & Mechanics

### [The Z Diagram: Connecting Force, Stress, Strain, and Displacement](posts/z-diagram-introduction/)

The Z Diagram is the conceptual starting point of this site. It connects force, stress, strain, and displacement through equilibrium, constitutive behavior, compatibility, and work and energy.
